title: Most robots installed vs highest robot density

source.name: World Robotics 2025 report (robot density by country)
source.publisher: International Federation of Robotics (IFR), via Supply Chain 247

notes: IFR World Robotics 2025: China installs more industrial robots in total than any other country, but ranks only 22nd in density at 166 per 10,000 workers (density up 17% year over year). South Korea ranks 1st in density at 1,220.

points.label: China (most robots installed, ranks 22nd in density)
